source: frontend-react/src/App.jsx at the Concept 7I checkpoint, before Concept 7J source edits

effects.purpose: Capture settings when the Propagation tool first becomes active, and clear the entry snapshot after leaving the tool.
orderingAssumptions: The ref detects the transition into the active Propagation tool; subsequent settings edits while still active do not replace the first-entry snapshot.
hiddenCoupling: This preserves Concept 7I first-mount defaults and intentionally differs from the latest settings value.
effects.candidateExtraction: Keep at the App/feature activation seam unless Propagation owns the snapshot without mounting early; do not move into an eager shared controller.

effects.purpose: Remember the most recent active Scenario for draft/source lineage fallback.
orderingAssumptions: scenarioSource reads the ref only when the active Scenario is absent and only when the ref's Project ID matches the current Project.
hiddenCoupling: The ref is a previous-value snapshot and must not leak a source Scenario across Project switches.
effects.candidateExtraction: Keep in App composition beside activeProject, activeScenario and scenarioSource.

effects.purpose: Dismiss an undo notice after six seconds.
effects.cleanup: clearTimeout on notice change or unmount
effects.candidateExtraction: Presentation-level UndoToast ownership is preferred if the notice action and timer move together; not an orchestration controller.

effects.purpose: Load API metadata initially and after a dataset switch revision changes.
effects.cleanup: isMounted guard suppresses state updates after unmount
orderingAssumptions: Metadata participates in dataset compatibility, RF defaults, project hydration and fingerprint/result lineage.
hiddenCoupling: Dataset switching intentionally increments datasetRevision to reload metadata.
effects.candidateExtraction: Application bootstrap remains App-owned; no new bootstrap service is justified by one request.

effects.purpose: Load the installed dataset catalog initially and after dataset switching.
effects.cleanup: isMounted guard suppresses state updates after unmount
orderingAssumptions: switchDataset uses the refreshed active_id to decide whether a later switch is needed.
hiddenCoupling: Catalog failure is presented in dataset UI and does not abort app bootstrap.
effects.candidateExtraction: Keep with application bootstrap and dataset selection in App.

effects.purpose: Load the active dataset's tower GeoJSON, map it into inventory cells, select a valid tower and mark the dataset revision hydrated.
effects.cleanup: isMounted guard suppresses state updates after unmount
orderingAssumptions: Workspace restore waits for non-empty towers; draft save waits for hydratedDatasetRevision to equal datasetRevision.
hiddenCoupling: Dataset switch clears towers before changing datasetRevision. This effect is a synchronization barrier for project restore and draft persistence.
effects.candidateExtraction: Keep in the explicit App bootstrap/dataset boundary unless hydration tests prove a hook preserves the same ordering.

effects.purpose: Load the active dataset's building summary.
effects.cleanup: isMounted guard suppresses state updates after unmount
orderingAssumptions: The summary is consumed by current RF reports and building-entry UI.
hiddenCoupling: Failure clears summary and does not fail the rest of bootstrap.
effects.candidateExtraction: Keep with bootstrap data until a dedicated dataset-owned state boundary exists.

effects.purpose: Drop or reorder selected network IDs that are invalid under the current tower inventory.
orderingAssumptions: Runs after dataset inventory changes; returns the same array when IDs are already canonical.
hiddenCoupling: Must not rewrite a valid saved selection or cause unnecessary project draft changes.
effects.candidateExtraction: Keep adjacent to inventory ownership; a pure normalization helper already owns the rule.

effects.purpose: Mark an incompatible project snapshot stale and clear a calibration profile when current metadata/settings make it incompatible.
orderingAssumptions: Uses active project snapshot and API metadata; can run around restorePlanningSnapshot and dataset metadata refresh.
hiddenCoupling: Clearing calibration also resets calibrationOffsetDb and marks the working plan dirty.
effects.candidateExtraction: Keep in App workspace/RF coordination; extracting separately could change hydration ordering.

effects.purpose: Restore the selected Project's active Scenario or draft once repository hydration and tower loading are ready.
stateMutated: all plan/result fields restored by restorePlanningSnapshot
orderingAssumptions: Must wait for local workspace load and non-empty dataset inventory; runs once per active Project ID.
hiddenCoupling: Uses restoredProjectRef to avoid replacing live user edits after hydration.
effects.candidateExtraction: Keep in App composition unless hydration controller API preserves Project, Scenario, inventory and dataset ordering explicitly.

effects.purpose: Persist current plan, inventory and selected map visibility after a 500 ms debounce.
effects.cleanup: clearTimeout on dependency change or unmount
orderingAssumptions: Requires loaded workspace, matching restoredProjectRef and completed tower hydration before writing.
hiddenCoupling: Captures a plan/inventory snapshot; it is not equivalent to deriving current plan from result data. It intentionally excludes transient analysis/research inputs.
effects.candidateExtraction: Candidate for a small workspace-draft synchronization hook only if the restore/save barrier and dependency set remain explicit; do not wrap useProjectWorkspace pass-through.

effects.purpose: Keep selected map cell on a cell represented by the currently rendered ray result.
orderingAssumptions: Runs after current simulation and network cell identity derivation.
hiddenCoupling: Changing this can change map inspection but should not invalidate RF inputs or result identity.
effects.candidateExtraction: Keep near map/result rendering; no new controller needed.

effects.purpose: Route Escape through open layer menu, path endpoint selection, polygon drawing and drawer/inspector states in priority order.
orderingAssumptions: Escape closes the narrowest active interaction first, then the drawer.
hiddenCoupling: Priority order is an accessibility and interaction contract.
effects.candidateExtraction: Keep at App composition with the existing drawer/map actions; do not move keyboard focus logic into an execution controller.

effects.purpose: Refresh Core Lab status/topology/session/event data immediately and every seven seconds while enabled and applicable.
effects.externalSystem: Core Lab API and browser timer
effects.cleanup: clearInterval on dependency change or unmount
orderingAssumptions: No polling while disabled or incompatible with the current 5G plan.
hiddenCoupling: The effect is the lifecycle owner for polling, while loading/error state and the lazy Core Lab view remain gated.
effects.candidateExtraction: Keep local to Core Lab activation when lazy lifecycle APIs can be preserved; avoid adding another general controller.

effects.purpose: Clear cached Core Lab details and show not-applicable status when the current plan no longer supports the feature.
orderingAssumptions: Runs after plan technology/profile changes; next applicable activation can refresh the API values.
hiddenCoupling: The selected Core Lab enabled flag survives as a UI selection, but stale topology/events/status are removed.
effects.candidateExtraction: Core Lab feature-local lifecycle candidate, but deferred until the feature contract can own this state without eagerly importing its implementation.

effects.purpose: Load spatial evidence for the currently inspected building.
effects.cleanup: AbortController aborts the previous request on ID change or unmount; AbortError is suppressed.
orderingAssumptions: The rendered evidence state is keyed by buildingID to avoid briefly showing a prior building response.
hiddenCoupling: Spatial evidence is diagnostic only and explicitly does not feed canonical RF behavior.
effects.candidateExtraction: Already local to the owning inspector; keep.

hiddenCouplingSummary: Project restore waits for both repository hydration and tower inventory; draft persistence additionally waits for dataset revision hydration.
Dataset switch increments a revision used by four independent fetch effects and clears the restore guard before these fetches complete.
PropagationResearchSettings captures first entry settings and must not be replaced by a latest-settings selector.
Core Lab polling and applicability cleanup are different lifecycle effects with different triggers.
Scenario source fallback is guarded by Project ID to avoid lineage leakage.

postChangeAudit.status: No App effect was extracted in 7J; App still contains 15 root effects and one same-file child effect.
postChangeAudit.decision: Hydration ordering and propagation first-entry snapshot remain in App because they depend on composition/lazy activation. Durable Run and report workflows were event-driven callback lifecycles; their extracted hooks require no lifecycle effects.
postChangeAudit.propagationSnapshotInvariant: The entry effect still captures settings on first activation and clears on leaving Propagation; it does not subscribe the lazy feature to subsequent settings edits.
